claims: The 2026 NFL Draft will be held from April 23–25, 2026, in Pittsburgh, PA.
The 2026 NFL Draft takes place at Acrisure Stadium and Point State Park.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft is on Thursday, April 23, 8 p.m. ET.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Friday, April 24, 7 p.m. ET.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Saturday, April 25, Noon ET.
Television coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft is available on NFL Network.
Television coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft is available on ABC.
Television coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft is available on ESPN Deportes.
The 2026 NFL Draft can be streamed on NFL+.
The 2026 NFL Draft can be streamed on the ESPN App.
The 2026 NFL Draft can be streamed on NFL Game Pass International.
The 2026 NFL Draft will feature 257 picks across seven rounds.
The first-round pick timer of the 2026 NFL Draft is reduced to eight minutes.
